verse.name: v1a
verse.lines: You expired, Jesus, but the source of life gushed forth for souls, and the ocean of mercy opened up for the whole world. O Fount of Life, unfathomable Divine Mercy, envelop the whole world and empty Yourself out upon us.

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines: O Blood and Water, which gushed forth from the Heart of Jesus as a fountain of Mercy for us, I trust in You!

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
I believe in God, the Father almighty, creator of heaven
and earth, and in Jesus Christ, his only Son, our
Lord, who was conceived by the Holy Spirit,
born of the Virgin Mary, suffered under Pontius
Pilate, was crucified, died and was buried; he
descended into hell; on the third day he rose again
from the dead; he ascended into heaven and is
seated at the right hand of God the Father almighty;
from there he will come to judge the living and the dead.
I believe in the Holy Spirit, the holy catholic Church,
the communion of saints, the forgiveness of sins,
the resurrection of the body, and life everlasting.
Amen.

verse.name: v1d
verse.lines:
Eternal Father
I offer You the Body and the Blood

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Soul and Divinity
Of Your dearly beloved Son

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Our Lord Jesus Christ
In atonement for our sins and those of the whole world

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: For the sake of His sorrowful Passion, have mercy on us and on the whole world

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Holy God, Holy Mighty One
Holy Immortal One have mercy on us and on the whole world

verse.name: v6a
verse.lines: O Blood and Water, which gushed forth from the Heart of Jesus as a fountain of Mercy for us, I trust in You!

verse.name: v6b
verse.lines:
Eternal God, in whom mercy is endless and the treasury
of compassion --- inexhaustible, look kindly upon us and increase Your mercy in us, that in difficult moments we might not despair nor become despondent, but with
great confidence submit ourselves to Your holy will,
which is Love and Mercy itself.
